subject: ophthalmology
title: Pupillary reflexes and abnormalities

steps.tx: Light reflex arcs retina to pretectum to both Edinger Westphal nuclei (consensual response), while near reflex triads convergence, accommodation and miosis through cortical pathways; light near dissociation (poor light, good near) flags dorsal midbrain or syphilis. **Anisocoria** greater in dark implicates sympathetic (Horner) failure, greater in light implicates parasympathetic (third nerve) failure. Slit lamp checks iris mechanics (posterior synechiae, atrophy, surgical damage) before neurology.
steps.say: Unequal pupils worse in dark is sympathetic; worse in light is parasympathetic. Light poor but near good dissociates dorsally.

steps.tx: **Relative afferent pupillary defect** (Marcus Gunn) reveals asymmetric optic nerve disease: swinging flashlight dilates the affected pupil paradoxically as light swings from good eye. Causes include optic neuritis, ischaemic neuropathy, severe glaucoma, retinal detachment and dense unilateral maculopathy; cataract never causes RAPD (media opacity dims equally). Grading by neutral density filters quantifies; bilateral symmetric disease hides RAPD. Every unexplained vision drop gets swinging light testing.
steps.say: Pupil dilating on light swing is afferent defect: nerve or severe retina, never cataract.

vis.alt: Diagram showing the swinging flashlight test for RAPD. Light on the good eye causes constriction, but swinging to the affected eye causes paradoxical dilation.
vis.caption: Swinging flashlight test for RAPD

steps.tx: **Horner syndrome** (ptosis, miosis, anhidrosis) localises by pharmacology and sweating: central (stroke, syringomyelia), preganglionic (Pancoast tumour, birth injury, neck surgery) and postganglionic (carotid dissection with neck pain, cluster headache, cavernous lesions). Cocaine confirms (fails to dilate), hydroxyamphetamine separates pre from post (releases stored noradrenaline only with intact terminals). Painful Horner with neck pain after trauma is carotid dissection until imaged urgently.
steps.say: Painful Horner after neck injury is carotid dissection: image now. Cocaine confirms, hydroxyamphetamine localises.

steps.tx: **Third nerve palsy** (down and out eye with ptosis; pupil involved with posterior communicating aneurysm compression, pupil spared in diabetic microvascular ischaemia) is the aneurysmal emergency rule: painful pupil involving third nerve images vessels immediately. **Tonic (Adie) pupil** (young women, poor light reaction with slow redilatation, segmental palsy with vermiform movements, denervation supersensitivity to weak pilocarpine) is benign with absent ankle jerks in Holmes Adie. **Argyll Robertson** (irregular small pupils reacting to accommodation not light, neurosyphilis with tabes) completes classic patterns.
steps.say: Painful blown pupil with down and out eye is aneurysm until scanned. Small irregular pupils ignoring light but squeezing near: neurosyphilis.
